Security.//: ApiKeyPepper and client-cert thumbprints MUST come from user-secrets / environment, never this file.

Proxy.//TrustedProxyCidrs: CIDRs of any L7 proxy in front of this one. Set it and X-Forwarded-For is believed from those sources only, so per-rule IP rules see the real client. Leave empty when facing clients directly — an empty list means the header is ignored and cannot be forged.
Proxy.//TlsMinVersion: tls1.2 or tls1.3 only. Caddy ignores any other value without complaint, so anything else is treated as tls1.2.
Proxy.//TlsCipherSuites: Comma-separated Go cipher names, TLS 1.2 only. Null keeps Go's defaults. An unrecognised name fails the whole config load — run POST /api/proxy/validate after changing it.
Proxy.//Timeouts: Data-plane timeouts in seconds; 0 leaves Caddy's default (which for read/write is none).
Proxy.//AccessLogPath: Enables the data-plane access log when set. These records contain client IPs and request URLs, so switching it on comes with a retention obligation.
